Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You run along the wreckage before the world catches up.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
Agility
Target / range / shape
Self, when a floor, ledge or support gives way
Duration
Immediate, before the triggering fall resolves.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Utility

Resolve before the fall. Movement can cross collapsing support but not empty air; end on a safe free square or suffer the remaining fall normally. No opportunity attacks. Carrying the ally requires a free hand and a supportable load; choose separate safe free endpoints for both of you.

Weak
Move 1 square toward a safe surface.
Standard
Move 2 squares toward a safe surface.
Strong
Move 3 squares and carry one adjacent willing ally with you.
